concepts.source_evidence: 4 Data Handling and Presentation If you ask your classmates about their favourite colours, you will get a list of colours.

concepts.source_evidence: Similarly, if you measure the weight of each student in your class, you would get a collection of measures of weight—again data.

concepts.name: Application
concepts.definition: Transfer the learned idea to a relevant new context.
concepts.source_evidence: Any collection of facts, numbers, measures, observations or other descriptions of things that convey information about those things is called data.
